alignment_rule: Entire combined GPU/CPU query lies within one sampling envelope. CPU busy also requires its complete OS counter interval inside that same envelope. No interpolation. NVML rolling windows are not known to be contained.

blocks.label: A

excluded_rolling_intervals.reason: CPU rolling interval not contained in action

quality.model_ready_scope: Sustained-block descriptive state association only; not causal, instantaneous, per-kernel or effective throughput evidence.

provider_semantics.utilization_semantics: Driver-defined rolling sample window; NVML documents product-dependent windows approximately 1 second to 1/6 second. Window boundaries are not exposed by these queries; values do not establish instantaneous activity, contention, kernel concurrency or causality.
provider_semantics.gpu_util_semantics: Percent of rolling interval with one or more kernels executing; includes the measured workload.
provider_semantics.power_semantics: NVML power usage is averaged over 1 second on Ampere (except GA100) and newer GPUs; architecture-dependent instantaneous semantics on older devices. This query does not expose averaging boundaries.
provider_semantics.clock_semantics: Observed clock query; not a per-action effective throughput measurement.

blocks.cpu_provider_semantics: Busy CPU time / total CPU time between consecutive successful OS reads; Windows kernel includes idle and scopes >64-CPU hosts to primary processor group; Linux iowait treated as idle; not per-process contention or frequency.
